description: Batch execution of Beans 0043 and 0051 in holon-coherence: Expose comprehensive optimization metrics in the web interface and CLI, and enable AGY and Claude Code harnesses to run against arbitrary / host-local LLM endpoints
goal: Implement and verify changes across holon-coherence for Beans 0043 and 0051: 1) EXPOSE COMPREHENSIVE OPTIMIZATION METRICS IN COHERENCE WEB UI & CLI (Bean 0043): Aggregate cumulative statistics across intercepted LLM transactions in src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py (total tool calls saved/pruned, total tokens reduced, global cache hit rate, average TTFT and decode throughput, total turns processed). Expose API endpoint intercepting GET /holon/api/metrics (and /_holon/metrics) returning live JSON metrics payload. Serve visual dashboard at /holon/ featuring real-time statistical cards (Tool Calls Saved, Tokens Reduced, Cache Hit Rate, Latency & Speedup) with auto-refresh capability. Expose 'holon-coherence metrics' CLI command in cli.py (and display in 'status' command) to print formatted terminal metrics. Update README.md and add unit tests in tests/test_mitm_addon.py and tests/test_cli.py. 2) AGY AND CLAUDE CODE RUNNERS AGAINST HOST-LOCAL LLM ENDPOINTS (Bean 0051): Support first-class endpoint and model selection in cli.py (extract_runner_flags, build_agent_env, run_agent) supporting --model and --local-llm-base / --local-llm-endpoint. For Claude Code, set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, model mapping, and suppress fallback. For AGY, set AGY_GATEWAY_URL (not GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), catalog alias resolution, and non-loopback endpoint spelling/alias to circumvent Go loopback proxy exemption. Implement protocol adapter rewrites in mitm_addon.py: strict Anthropic normalizer stripping thinking, output_config, context_management, vendor anthropic-beta headers, and suppressing injected cache_control when targeting non-cloud servers, with incremental SSE streaming pass-through; and Gemini bridge translating Gemini v1beta generateContent/streamGenerateContent to OpenAI /v1/chat/completions (or Anthropic /v1/messages) with bidirectional tool call, message, and usage translation. Retain exact cloud behavior when no local endpoint is declared. Update README.md and AGENTS.md documentation and add comprehensive unit tests. 3) VERIFICATION: Ensure all unit tests (pytest -m 'not integration_test') pass, ruff check and ruff format are clean.

description: Execute Bean 0096 in holon-coherence: proactive port conflict checks for ports 8080 and 8081 with dynamic fallback mapping, explicit container down status indicator, dynamic port discovery in status command, default ~/.holon/logs fallback in metrics command, and comprehensive prefill, tail prefill, generation, KV cache, and reasoning metrics in the web dashboard and CLI
goal: Implement and verify changes across holon-coherence for Bean 0096: 1) PROACTIVE PORT CONFLICT CHECKS & DYNAMIC FALLBACK (commands/start.py): Proactively check if default proxy port 8080 or web dashboard port 8081 are already bound/in-use on the host before running Docker. If occupied, automatically locate an available alternative port on the host, map the Docker host port to it (-p 127.0.0.1:{actual_port}:{internal_port}), notify the user with a clear warning, and fail fast if Docker fails to expose ports. 2) CONTAINER DOWN STATUS INDICATOR (commands/docker_ops.py): When holon-coherence status runs and the container is not running, output an explicit status indicator that holon-coherence is down (not running) rather than only dumping an empty docker ps header. 3) DYNAMIC PORT DISCOVERY (commands/docker_ops.py): Inspect actual runtime published ports via docker port to accurately determine host ports for proxy metrics and web dashboard, and only display web token/dashboard URLs if port 8081 is published. 4) OFFLINE LOG FALLBACK (commands/metrics.py): Check ~/.holon/logs automatically when WIRE_LOG_DIR is unset. 5) COMPREHENSIVE THROUGHPUT & METRICS (mitm_addon.py, commands/metrics.py): Track prefill throughput (tok/s), tail prefill throughput (tok/s), decode/generation throughput (tok/s), provider KV cache hit ratio, and reasoning tokens in CumulativeMetrics. Pass prefill_tps into record_response, expose all fields in /holon/api/metrics JSON, and add dedicated prominent cards for Prefill Speed, Generation Speed, KV Cache, and Reasoning Tokens, plus a live recent transaction table in the /holon/ web dashboard. 6) TESTS & DOCS: Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_mitm_addon.py verifying all new behaviors and maintain 100% passing tests.

description: Execute Bean 0097 in holon-coherence: fix prompt prefill throughput reporting 0.00 tok/s, stop non-streaming requests from corrupting decode throughput with physically impossible 34k-38k tok/s values, guard throughput math against near-zero durations, and audit every telemetry metric for mathematical consistency across CumulativeMetrics, /holon/api/metrics, the web dashboard, the CLI scorecard and the offline wire-log parser
goal: Implement and verify changes across holon-coherence for Bean 0097: 1) PREFILL THROUGHPUT NEVER REPORTS ZERO (mitm_addon.py, commands/metrics.py): prefill_tps must equal prompt tokens divided by a genuine TTFT in seconds whenever prompt tokens > 0 and TTFT > 0. Audit every endpoint family (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible) so ttft is captured from the real request start and the real first-token/first-payload arrival, never defaulted to now (which yields ttft = 0.0 and prefill 0.00 tok/s). Guard against missing or zero request_start_time / response_headers_time / first_chunk_time by leaving the sample unmeasured instead of recording 0.0, so avg_prefill_throughput_tps, latest_prefill_tps, avg_tail_prefill_tps and latest_tail_prefill_tps stay faithful in CumulativeMetrics, /holon/api/metrics, holon-coherence metrics and _read_offline_metrics. 2) DECODE THROUGHPUT ONLY FROM GENUINE STREAMING (mitm_addon.py): stop computing output_tps as output_tokens / (total_time - ttft) for non-streaming responses, because headers and the full body arrive in the same network chunk so generation_time collapses to socket parse time (~0.001s) and yields absurd 34,000-38,000 tok/s values that poison the cumulative average. Compute decode throughput exclusively from real SSE chunk intervals (first_chunk_time to last_chunk_time), require a streaming response flag, and treat generation durations below a realistic 0.05s floor as unmeasured rather than as samples. Expose decode throughput as null/unmeasured for those requests and keep avg_decode_throughput_tps and latest_decode_throughput_tps averages over valid streaming samples only. 3) FULL METRIC CONSISTENCY AUDIT (mitm_addon.py, commands/metrics.py): verify total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, total_cache_read_tokens, total_cache_creation_tokens, total_reasoning_tokens, provider_cache_hit_rate (cache_read / total_input), cache_hit_rate (cache_hits / total_requests), tool_calls_pruned (tool_outputs_omitted), tokens_reduced, chars_saved, avg_ttft_ms (sum_ttft_ms / count_ttft), avg_prefill_throughput_tps, latest_prefill_tps, avg_tail_prefill_tps, latest_tail_prefill_tps, avg_decode_throughput_tps and latest_decode_throughput_tps are computed with identical formulas, identical zero/None guards and identical rounding in the live in-memory proxy, the /holon/ dashboard, the terminal scorecard and the offline wire-log parser. 4) TESTS: add comprehensive unit tests in tests/test_mitm_addon.py and tests/test_cli.py asserting exact prefill and decode tok/s for streaming and non-streaming responses, asserting non-streaming requests never enter the decode average, asserting sub-50ms generation windows are rejected, asserting missing-timing samples do not produce 0.00 prefill, and asserting live and offline metric aggregation agree. 5) VERIFICATION: keep uv run task lint and uv run task test fully green.

questions.question: Should decode throughput be reported as 0.00 for non-streaming requests or omitted entirely?
questions.answer: Omitted. Non-streaming decode throughput is physically meaningless, so the per-request value is reported as null/unmeasured and the request never contributes to avg_decode_throughput_tps.

questions.question: What streaming duration floor should reject unreliable decode samples?
questions.answer: 0.05 seconds, matching the acceptance criteria in Bean 0097.

questions.question: May the fix change the JSON contract of /holon/api/metrics?
questions.answer: Only additively. Existing keys keep their names and semantics; unmeasured throughput values become null instead of a fabricated float.

description: Execute Bean 0098 in holon-coherence: implement comprehensive A/B testing suite, CLI benchmark runner, differential scorecards, integration tests, and operator documentation for token reduction validation
goal: Build an extensive A/B testing suite and operator documentation for evaluating holon-coherence token reduction, cache hit efficacy, and latency metrics: 1) A/B TESTING HARNESS / RUNNER (src/holon_coherence/commands/ab_test.py): Implement 'holon-coherence ab-test' CLI command that takes multi-turn agent payload traces and executes reproducible comparisons between Variant A (Baseline / Control: unoptimized or HOLON_PASSIVE_MONITORING=1) and Variant B (Optimized / Treatment: active token reduction, payload cleaning, cache breakpoint injection, semantic disk caching). Compute differential scorecards: Total Tokens (input, output, cache read), Context Reduction (% prompt tokens reduced, chars saved), Tool Calls Pruned, Latency & TTFT deltas, and Semantic Parity verification. 2) CLI INTEGRATION: Wire 'ab-test' into holon_coherence.cli dispatch with options for baseline port/mode, optimized port/mode, trace payload file path, rounds, and output formats (table, JSON). 3) INTEGRATION & REGRESSION TEST SUITE (tests/test_ab_testing.py): Comprehensive tests covering multi-turn repetitive tool traces, Anthropic and OpenAI cache breakpoint assertions, SSE streaming delivery equivalence, and statistically significant token reduction assertions (>20% on repetitive tool output traces). 4) OPERATOR DOCUMENTATION (docs/ab_testing_guide.md, README.md): Step-by-step operator guide covering local, Docker, and CI benchmarking, configuration flags, scorecard interpretation, and Rule 10 authentic data sampling methodology. 5) VERIFICATION: 100% clean test passes and ruff lint clean.

questions.question: Should ab-test support both offline replay of transaction logs and live dual-proxy comparison?
questions.answer: Yes. Support replaying authentic wire-log traces from transactions.jsonl as well as hitting live endpoints.

questions.question: What is the primary CLI command name?
questions.answer: 'holon-coherence ab-test' integrated into the main CLI dispatcher.

description: Execute Beans 0101 and 0102 in holon-coherence: default proxy to active optimization, implement session-wide tool deduplication, and standardize telemetry rate terminology on throughput across CLI and dashboard
goal: 1) Active optimization by default: ensure container start, CLI runners, and proxy interceptor initialization default to active optimization (COHERENCE_TOKEN_REDUCTION=1, HOLON_PASSIVE_MONITORING=0), with passive monitoring strictly opt-in via flags or headers. 2) Session-wide tool output deduplication: retire _RECENT_TURNS_TO_KEEP = 6 window limitation in payload_cleaner.py; track tool output content hashes across the entire multi-turn trajectory; replace repeated tool output bodies with structured tombstones while strictly preserving tool protocol envelopes (tool_use_id, tool_call_id, tool name, turn structure) and maintaining KV cache prefix alignment. 3) Standardize rate terminology on Throughput: unify Prefill Throughput (tokens/sec) and Tail Prefill Throughput (tokens/sec) across CLI scorecard, web dashboard, metrics math, A/B testing scorecard, test assertions, and documentation. 4) Verification: 100% clean test passes and ruff lint clean.

questions.answer: Yes, compaction preserves KV cache prefix alignment and tool call protocol IDs.
